rate_limit.correction: 上一个版本说“规划接口没有限流”是错的。443 入口容器 travel-https-edge 的 nginx 早已按真实公网 IP 对 /travel/api/plan/stream、/plan/jobs、/plan/jobs/create 做 6r/m + burst 2 限流（zone travel_plan）；trips 的 AI 接口另有 travel_ai 6r/m。

rate_limit.app_layer: PUBLIC_QUOTAS 增加了对应表项（5/60s）作为“没有反向代理、直接跑 uvicorn”时的兜底，但生产 TRAVEL_SHARED_LIMITS=0，未启用——两道叠加会把实际额度压到更严的一道。
rate_limit.safety_added: SharedPublicLimits 增加私有/回环 peer 跳过：反代没传真实 IP 时所有用户共用一个 key，按它限流会挡住全站。

known_limits: Nginx forwards X-Forwarded-For with $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for, so a client that spoofs the leftmost value can evade per-IP quotas. Switch to $remote_addr if abuse becomes real.
Rate limiting is per client IP; a shared NAT (campus, office) will hit the 5/minute ceiling collectively.
Production host still cannot reach zh.wikivoyage.org; corpus updates keep using export/import.
Citation matching is name-based; an alias the chunk never mentions cannot be linked.
Density is observed in the log and in itinerary.density but does not trigger regeneration.
